summary_md:
# #451 Skistarsäsongen

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-10-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

MarketMakers #451 opens with macro: Swedish fuel tax relief is being rolled back, the Riksbank may raise rates, US long yields are above 5.2% and the US yield curve may invert, while AI investment keeps the economy and the large indices strong and small caps lag large caps sharply. The main stock topics are the hosts' yearly autumn pitch to buy Skistar after a strong Q4, buying the dip in Better Collective and Kambi after Brazil's proposed betting ban ahead of the 4 October election, and Hemnet's falling share price. The episode ends with Robinhood's new 24/7 trading and AI agents, Telia's reminder of a weak Q3 before its quiet period, and a sponsor interview with Qanor.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SKIS-B — Skistar | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Yearly autumn buy pitch: strong Q4 with a smaller loss and revenue +30%, record winter bookings +3%, Swedish consumer recovering, 15% shareholder discount from 200 shares.

#### Reasoning

Host buys Skistar almost every early autumn after the Q4 report. Seasonal timing is good as the winter season approaches. Q4 was unusually strong: smaller loss, revenue up ~30% on summer demand, organic growth and a NOK/SEK tailwind. Winter bookings are a record +3% and management says Swedish guests are returning. The plan is to sell after the sports holiday; the shareholder discount adds return. Host says it has usually been a good trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- after the sports holiday (seasonal exit)
- if winter bookings weaken
- if the Swedish consumer turns down as fuel taxes and rates rise

> *"Det känns som att nu är det den tiden på året igen när det är dags att köpa Skistar aktier."*

---

### 🟢 BETCO — Better Collective | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Fell 40% on the Brazil betting ban; both hosts bought. Fair drop is estimated at 15-20%. Bolsonaro's 60% election odds on 4 Oct could reverse the ban; buybacks are running.

#### Reasoning

Brazil is 25-30% of profit but already shrinking, and the business is mainly sportsbook, which is less at risk. Probability-weighted, a 15-20% fall looks fair versus the actual 40%. Near-term trigger: the 4 Oct election, where Bolsonaro (60% on Polymarket) opposes the ban, plus possible legal challenges. A short-term trade aiming for a ~10% bounce; the host does not like the company long term and keeps a small position.

#### Sell Triggers

- Lula wins the 4 Oct election and the ban goes through
- after a ~10% bounce is captured
- if sportsbook is also banned permanently

> *"Och jag har faktiskt köpt in aktien på grund av det. Tycker att RR ser väldigt bra ut."*

---

### 🟢 KAMBI — Kambi | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Brazil is a low single-digit share of revenue and the impact is limited, yet the drop looks too big. Option of sportsbook being spared. A host bought a little.

#### Reasoning

Kambi says Brazil is low single-digit revenue (1-3%). Its lower margin and regulated-only model mean lost revenue hits profit more, but the share-price fall still looks excessive. If sportsbook is spared or Bolsonaro wins, the stock should bounce. Both hosts think the full downside is already priced in, giving a good risk/reward.

#### Sell Triggers

- Lula wins and sportsbook is banned
- if Brazil exposure turns out larger than guided

> *"Och jag har faktiskt köpt in lite Kambi också på grund av det."*

---

### ⛔ EVO — Evolution | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Seen as the biggest loser after Better Collective: ~9% Brazil exposure per JP Morgan, a physical studio in Brazil, and unlikely to move to black-market revenue. A host shorted it and is now flat.

#### Reasoning

High Brazil exposure (JP Morgan: 9%) and fixed investment in a local studio. Given scrutiny of its unregulated revenue, Evolution is unlikely to keep serving Brazil through grey or black channels. The host shorted it and closed after a 10% fall; he is now neither long nor short but sees more downside risk than for its peers.

#### Sell Triggers

- Bolsonaro wins and the ban is reversed
- if Brazil exposure proves smaller than 9%

> *"Men tror att utöver Better Collective så kan nog Evo vara den som förlorar mest på det hela faktiskt."*

---

### 🟠 HEM — Hemnet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Down 60%+ YTD; switching to free listings and lower prices; buybacks paused. Strong position but 'not worth buying now'; may turn cheap in a year or so.

#### Reasoning

The golden period is over: the CEO sold at the top, Booli is taking share, and its reputation is hurt. Free listings will cut revenue per listing sharply, which is very negative short term. Still, the cost cuts, the new model and its dominant site position could eventually make it cheap. The host warns against catching a falling knife and says the stock could fall much more.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the free-listing model triggers a pricing race to the bottom
- if traffic share keeps shifting to Booli

> *"Jag tycker ändå det kan bli spännande att följa, men inte köpvärt här i dagsläget."*

---

### 🟠 HOOD — Robinhood | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Growth >30% and profit up ~50% in July. Launching 24/7 trading, AI agents and possibly prediction markets. High valuation; 'maybe time to look'.

#### Reasoning

The July report beat expectations with strong growth. New products (weekend trading, agent accounts with 150k users, prediction markets) should boost brokerage revenue, since the company earns when customers trade and lose. The hosts note the high valuation (around P/E 50) and are only floating a look, not buying.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation stays stretched without earnings follow-through
- regulatory pushback on AI agent trading

> *"Det kanske är dags att börja kolla lite på Robinhood ändå, det kanske är lite bortglömda aktien då."*

---

### 🟡 HACK — Hacksaw | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

A host holds it unchanged; Brazil impact is likely a few percent because much of its revenue is unregulated. The stock fell a bit more than it should have.

#### Reasoning

Brazil is at most 10% of revenue as its largest region, likely a few percent. Some licensed revenue will disappear, but grey and black revenue can continue, so the impact is small. The drop looks slightly excessive. A host keeps his existing position; the hosts call it not the nicest company in the industry.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Brazil exposure proves larger
- regulatory action against unregulated revenue

> *"Aktien är ändå ner rätt mycket på det här. Lite mer än den kanske borde gått ner."*

---
